classification.difficultyReason: Read two marked points, compute the gradient and interpret it as a rate; short and fully signposted.

content.prompt: The linear model shows the volume of water in a tank as it fills.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Find the gradient of the line.

answer.worked:
By choosing $(0,300)$ and $(4,900)$:
$$\begin{align*}m&=\frac{\text{change in volume}}{\text{change in time}}\\&=\frac{900-300}{4-0}\\&=150\end{align*}$$

answer.short: The volume increases by 150 L per minute.
answer.worked: The gradient is the change in volume per minute, so the tank fills at $150$ L per minute.
